decision: Keep the native reward fixed. Add a configurable GAE lambda for an isolated future training comparison; do not replace the current experiment.
reason: The trained critics convey useful future-return information, so the data do not support a generally non-learning critic. Delayed residual weighting remains a testable hypothesis.
current_performance_priority: Complete the existing input-scaling pilot and all six conflict-feature runs before interpreting their complete results.
no_claim: Higher lambda has not been shown to improve trained policies. Offline agreement with realized returns does not estimate policy-gradient variance or establish causality.
limitations: Two reused development worlds, not new performance evidence.
Deterministic trajectory returns differ from the stochastic-policy returns the critic was trained to predict.
Full-trajectory GAE here differs from actual finite training rollouts and is diagnostic only.
Aircraft-level predicted flags need not refer to the same pair as a later observed conflict.
A delayed reward or a short residual weighting scale does not prove a learning bug; a good critic can convey long-term consequences.
No models, training parameters, rewards or evaluation settings change.
